name: gf_kick_train
what: both giant fibres (DNp01) kicked by 100 mV, enough for one spike each, every 50 ms from 200 ms (20 kicks), as scripts/probes/gf_latency.py does
evidence: DNp01 is the giant fibre (male-cns type; measured identity). The kick stands in for the visual looming drive, which is not modelled; the stimulus-to-GF-spike time is therefore not part of the readout
notes: kick steps are round(start_ms/dt) + i * round(period_ms/dt), i = 0..count-1
